## About

**GreenEquity HN** maps urban ecology and green equity across Heilbronn's districts.
District boundaries, green space and water come from OpenStreetMap; NDVI and soil sealing
are derived from Sentinel-2 (Copernicus). Built as an application demo for the **GEP@HHN**
project (Hochschule Heilbronn, ref. 314-IB) on GIS and urban ecology.
